payload.author: claude
payload.body: Shipped RedisRegionBus (apps/server/src/cluster/region-redis-bus.ts): production Redis pub/sub cross-region transport mirroring RedisClusterBus one level up. msgpack codec, dedicated subscriber connection, originRegionId loop guard, ready promise, best-effort logging, createRedisRegionBus ioredis helper reusing the same RedisBusClient interface. Plugs into FederatingClusterBus where MemoryRegionBus does; strictly additive. Tests: fake-client suite (federation, loop guard, encode/decode round-trip, close unsubscribes) + Redis-gated integration that skips without FRICK_REDIS_URL. Gate green: 1079 server tests pass, 0 failures.
